originals.citation: Yamada, K., Gerber, D. J., et al. (2007). Genetic analysis of the calcineurin pathway identifies members of the EGR gene family, specifically EGR3, as potential susceptibility candidates in schizophrenia. PNAS.

quote: pedigree and case-control analyses in a study utilizing a Japanese sample found that EGR3 was significantly associated with schizophrenia; this result was also replicated in a Korean population study. However, subsequent studies utilizing a Japanese sample and a Chinese sample failed to replicate this finding.
notes: Framed as testing the EGR3 association first reported by Yamada 2007 in a Han Chinese sample; Kim2010, Liu2010, Kyogoku2010 are follow-up replications pooled in the meta-analysis, not the tested finding's source. Could arguably add @kim2010. Not framed as a strict replication.
